visual.general_description: Infographic timeline arrow with five month-year segments (October 2018 to May 2020) and boxes above and below describing therapy, psoriasis, treatment interruption and resumption, and PET response.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background infographic with a horizontal blue arrow pointing right, divided into five segments labelled October 2018, November 2018, May 2019, June 2019 and May 2020. Above the arrow, three boxes with downward arrows read: "Start therapy with Pembrolizumab 200 mg flat dose every three weeks" (pointing to the November 2018 segment), "Start therapy with Apremilast and Methylprednisolone (discontinued after 15 days)" (pointing to the May 2019 segment) and "Patient continued Apremilast treatment with no psoriasis exacerbation" (pointing to the May 2020 segment). Below the arrow, four boxes with upward arrows read: "Metastatic melanoma diagnosis" (October 2018 segment), "After tenth cycle, patient developed psoriasis (PASI 12,3). Pembrolizumab was interrupted" (May 2019 segment), "After 4 weeks due to disappearance of skin manifestations treatment with Pembrolizumab was resumed" (June 2019 segment) and "PET WB confirmed Complete Response (CR) as per iRECIST 1.1" (May 2020 segment). The printed text is pixel content transcribed here only for the visual record.
